elements.name: Stone Sense
elements.desc: You can sense the shape of stonework within 30 feet, even through walls.

elements.name: Stoneborn
elements.desc: Hardy folk of the deep hills. +2 Constitution, speed 25 ft.

elements.name: Tinker's Insight
elements.desc: Once per short rest, add your Intelligence modifier to a check made with tools.

elements.name: Tinkerer
elements.desc: A quick-handed inventor who solves problems with gadgets and a little magic.

elements.name: Pebble Barrage
elements.desc: Hurl a spray of pebbles at a creature you can see. It makes a Dexterity save or takes 2d6 bludgeoning damage.

elements.name: Charm of the Hearth
elements.desc: A small iron charm, always warm. While attuned to it you gain +1 AC and +1 to saving throws.
